[SWS_LOG_00231] Console output of raw binary data
⌈
A message argument value
of type
ara::core::Span<const ara::core::Byte>
shall be output to console
as a sequence of hexadecimal octets separated by apostrophe characters (U+0027).
⌋
(RS_LT_00002)
Example:
48656c6f
